purpose: Textbook surface-patch segmentation of the frozen source point clouds, per source, on raw points, for every object class: smoothness-constraint region growing (Rabbani, van den Heuvel & Vosselman 2006; PCL RegionGrowing) followed by Euclidean clustering of the residual (PCL EuclideanClusterExtraction). Patches are typed by eigen-features (Weinmann et al. 2015). No building prior, no source decision, no pairing. [injection bench V4: als_shift_all (H_delta_x); inputs are the perturbed partition copies under phase-payloads/phd/injection_bench_v1/PHD-INJECTION-BENCH-v1/V4; the relation map is the frozen original]

algorithm.name: VOSSELMAN_PLANAR_SURFACE_GROWING_PLUS_EUCLIDEAN_CLUSTERING_v1
references: Rabbani T., van den Heuvel F., Vosselman G. (2006) Segmentation of point clouds using smoothness constraint. ISPRS Archives XXXVI-5

Vosselman G., Gorte B.G.H., Sithole G., Rabbani T. (2004) Recognising structure in laser scanner point clouds. ISPRS Archives XXXVI-8/W2 (surface growing); Vosselman G., Maas H.-G. (eds.) (2010) Airborne and Terrestrial Laser Scanning, Whittles, ch. 2 segmentation
Rusu R.B., Cousins S. (2011) 3D is here: Point Cloud Library (PCL). ICRA; classes RegionGrowing, EuclideanClusterExtraction
Weinmann M., Jutzi B., Hinz S., Mallet C. (2015) Semantic point cloud interpretation based on optimal neighborhoods. ISPRS JPRS 105
algorithm.semantics: Normals and curvature from k-NN PCA. Growth criterion 'planar_surface' (Vosselman surface growing): seeds in ascending curvature; a neighbour joins the region if its normal is within smoothness_deg of the REGION plane normal (sign-invariant) and its distance to the region plane is below max_point_to_plane_m; the region plane is PCA-refit at every doubling of the member count (accepted only if conditioned and within smoothness_deg of the seed normal). Regions below min_cluster_points are released. The pure Rabbani/PCL criterion 'smoothness' (neighbour-vs-current-point angle + curvature gate) is kept as an alternative; on dense-image MVS it either fragments the ground (strict) or leaks across ground, vegetation and roofs (loose), see technical return. Residual points: Euclidean clustering; clusters below euclidean_min_points are explicit NOISE (label 0), never deleted.
algorithm.parameter_provenance: k 60 (MVS) / 20 (ALS): neighbourhood radius ~0.35 m / ~0.5 m so that MVS normal noise (~7 cm rms ground) averages out; smoothness 15 deg = surface_patch_v1 base normal angle; max_point_to_plane 0.15 m = S1 legacy RANSAC tolerance; min_cluster 50 = PCL tutorial default (ALS 15 scaled to ~22 pts/m2); Euclidean tolerance = 2-3 x mean spacing. The pilot sweep of the pure smoothness criterion (k 30/60/100 x 10/15/20 deg x curvature 0.03/0.05/0.10) is recorded in the technical return.

typing.rule: PLANAR if the patch plane RMSE <= planar_max_rmse_m (same 0.15 m tolerance as the S1 legacy RANSAC); LINEAR if linearity=(l1-l2)/l1 >= linearity_min and sphericity=l3/l1 < 0.05; else SCATTERED. Eigen-features follow Weinmann et al. 2015 but are applied at patch level only for the linear test.
typing.area_proxy: occupied 0.25 m cells of the projection on the patch PCA plane

algorithm.smoothness_sweep_note: pure Rabbani/PCL criterion on MVS: strict (k60,15deg,c0.05) -> ground split into a 51k-point region plus a 38k-point residual cluster; loose (k100,10deg,c0.10) -> one 111k-point region with plane RMSE 1.33 m (ground+low vegetation+roofs merged).
